summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB sibling payload
details: @onereach/step-run-snowflake-query@0.1.2 declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style `_0xNNNN` identifiers, string-lookup indirection) and downloads a Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and invokes `math_init.js` under that Bun binary via `execFileSync`. math_init.js is a ~727KB single-line file with hex-obfuscated identifiers, a large opaque numeric string-array constant table, and a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header indicating it is authored to run only under the fetched Bun runtime. Neither the runtime fetch nor the payload is documented in the README, and neither is related to the package's advertised Snowflake-query functionality. The alternate-runtime dispatch also causes the payload to bypass Node-focused inspection. Installing the package auto-executes the obfuscated payload on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
